about: The collecta of the formulary “7th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Whose providence never fails to set things in order, we humbly beseech You to remove from us whatever is harmful and grant whatever is for our benefit. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
